# VEDIXA ERP

> Smart Business & Billing Management Platform for Fertilizers, Seeds, and Pesticides.

## Overview
VEDIXA ERP is an enterprise resource planning software designed for fertilizer, seed, and pesticide businesses in India. It supports fast GST billing, FIFO & batch-wise inventory tracking, customer ledgers, supplier ledgers, WhatsApp invoice sharing, and real-time business analytics.
